enrichment_fields.name: rank
enrichment_fields.description: Up to 3 published rankings you actually know: organisation, position or band, year. If none, an AI estimate of standing (national/regional tier) with its basis; no invented numbers or sources.

enrichment_fields.name: entry
enrichment_fields.description: Admission requirements: qualifications, application route, entrance exams, language tests, and portfolio/audition/interview where relevant. Acceptance rate only if known.

enrichment_fields.name: cost_shape
enrichment_fields.description: Approximate annual tuition: currency, domestic vs international, academic year if known; a range if estimated. Tuition only, not living costs.

enrichment_fields.name: contact
enrichment_fields.description: Official admissions/general email, phone or contact page you actually know. Otherwise the record's website, written as 'General website: <url>'.
